title: Core Features
subtitle: Discover the major capabilities available in TaraHive.

blocks.text: TaraHive provides a comprehensive collection of travel planning tools designed for both solo travelers and groups.

items: Collaborate with friends and family in shared trips.
Check weather forecasts before and during your trip.
Use SOS and emergency features for added safety.
Access your trips across supported devices.

blocks.text: Some features may require an internet connection or location permission.
